data.name: BlankGPS
data.shortDescription: Disable specific GPS markers and navigate with proximity beep to enhance the exploration experience
data.description:
BlankGPS aims to enhance exploration by allowing you to disable any combination of the default cave, bunker, and/or Team B GPS markers.

Additionally, BlankGPS allows for proximity discovery - the GPS will beep faster the closer you get to a given marker, and, if enabled, the marker will appear on the GPS once you've reached it.

All features are optional. Enjoy enhanced exploration on the island!
